DASH.RANKS_DESC: View invite ranks of your server.
DASH.ROLE_DESC: The role that will be given to the user when they reach this rank.
DASH.INVITES_DESC: The amount of invites the user needs to reach this rank.

ADD.USER_DESC: the user to give invites to
ADD.INVITES_DESC: the number of invites to give
ADD.INVALID_USER: Invalid syntax: You need to mention a target user
ADD.BOT: Oops! You cannot add invites to bots

CODES.DESCRIPTION: list all your invites codes in this guild
CODES.USER_DESC: the user to get the invite codes for
CODES.NOT_FOUND: `{{user}}` has no invites in this server

IMPORT.DESCRIPTION: add existing guild invites to users
IMPORT.USER_DESC: the user to import invites for
IMPORT.BOT: Oops! You cannot import invites for bots
IMPORT.SUCCESS_ALL: Successfully imported existing invites for all users

INVITER.USER_DESC: the user to get the inviter information for
INVITER.DISABLED: Invite tracking is disabled in this server

INVITES.DESCRIPTION: shows number of invites in this server
INVITES.USER_DESC: the user to get the invites for
INVITES.DISABLED: Invite tracking is disabled in this server

RANK.ADD_INVITES_DESC: number of invites required to obtain the role
RANK.REMOVE_DESC: remove a previously configured invite rank
RANK.INVALID_ROLE: No role found matching that name {{match}}
RANK.DISABLED: Invite tracking is disabled in this server
RANK.BOT_ROLE: I cannot assign bot roles to members
RANK.EVERYONE_ROLE: I cannot assign `everyone` role to members
RANK.MISSING_PERM: I am missing permissions to move members to that role. Is that role below my highest role?
RANK.PREVIOUS_FOUND: Previous configuration found for this role. Overwriting data...
RANK.NOT_FOUND: No previous invite rank is configured found for this role

RANKS.DESCRIPTION: shows the invite ranks configured on this guild
RANKS.NO_RANKS: No invite ranks configured in this server

RESET.USER_DESC: the user to clear invites for
RESET.INVALID_USER: Incorrect syntax. You must mention a target

TRACKER.DESCRIPTION: enable or disable invite tracking in the server
TRACKER.MISSING_PERMS:
Oops! I am missing `Manage Server`, `Manage Channels` permission!
I cannot track invites
TRACKER.MISSING_PERMS_CHANNEL:
I may not be able to track invites properly
I am missing `Manage Channel` permission in the following channels ```{{channels}}```
